headline: Diesel: from today the discount is halved, Eni freezes prices for 30 days. How much it costs to fill up
summary: The diesel excise tax cut falls to 6 cents from today. Energy company Eni has set a 30-day price freeze, and the government hopes other operators will follow.
why: Eni is Italy's major integrated energy company and a large fuel retailer. Excise changes and pump price policy feed directly into Italian fuel prices and inflation.

impacts.name: Eni
impacts.why: Eni's 30-day price cap on diesel directly sets its retail pump prices during the excise change.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
